notes: The cursor: zrender Handler.mousemove calls proxy.setCursor(target ? target.cursor : 'default') before it dispatches anything; then the zr-level listeners run: a RoamController (graph, tree, sankey, treemap, geo, map, an inside dataZoom) sets 'grabbing' while it pans (moveOnMouseMove) and otherwise 'grab' when the event has no target and the pointer passes its _checkPointer -- the lowest precedence (_decideCursorStyle); on mouseup the same controller sets 'grab' there, else the target's cursor or 'default'. Nothing is done while globalPan is taken (a brush). HandlerProxy writes `cursor || 'default'`.

Which elements carry which cursor: Displayable.prototype.cursor = 'pointer'; silent elements are no target (findHover goes on below them). Series: bar, pictorialBar (each glyph), candlestick, scatter / effectScatter / line symbols, pie, sunburst, a treemap leaf's content rect: itemModel.getShallow('cursor') -- the item, its level (treemap / sunburst) or category (graph), the series, the root option; a graph node: item.get('cursor'), else 'move' when draggable; a draggable sankey node: 'move'; LargeSymbolDraw / LargeLineDraw: 'default'. Components: a graphic element its `cursor`; a matrix cell its `cursor`; a scrolling legend's page button 'pointer' / 'default' by canJump; a continuous visualMap's handle thumbs and labels getCursor(orient), its in-range bar the same when calculable; a slider dataZoom's handles ew- / ns-resize, its move zone grab / grabbing, its click panel crosshair under brushSelect; brush covers move / the resizes. Everything else that is not silent: pointer.

Pictures: each ZRImage is given __image (its PNG's natural size) and its onload, as a browser's load would, then a frame; the corners are its style rect (x, y, getWidth(), getHeight()) through its global transform.

cases.note: a bar is its item's cursor, else its series', else the prototype's pointer; a label is a text of its own (pointer, whatever its bar says); empty ground, a title without link or triggerEvent, an axis label without triggerEvent: default; a legend item: its hit rect's pointer
the root option's cursor reaches every item (getShallow climbs the item model, the series, the global model); a legend item is not a series' (pointer)
a title with triggerEvent or a link (its subtext with a sublink) and an axis label or name with triggerEvent answer the pointer: pointer
a silent series and its labels are no target; a legend without selectedMode has only silent children
a line's symbols take the item / series cursor; its polyline and area are elements of their own (pointer)
a large scatter is one element, LargeSymbolDraw's cursor 'default' whatever the series says
a sector is its item's cursor, else pointer; its label is a text (pointer)
a sunburst piece: its item's cursor, else its level's (the item model's parent), else the series'
a treemap leaf's content rect takes the node's cursor (level, series); its label is pointer; the breadcrumb pointer; roam (true by default) grabs where nothing is hovered and grabs while it pans

steps.aim: the border of parent a (its background)

cases.note: a draggable node with no cursor option is 'move'; an item cursor wins over it; a node draggable false keeps pointer; an edge pointer; the RoamController grabs over its area where nothing is hovered, grabbing while it pans, grab again on release

a graph on a cartesian2d: a draggable node with no cursor option is "move" (setDraggable whatever the coordinate system), an item cursor wins, draggable false keeps pointer; a drag moves the node (the pointer outruns it on the move of the drag: default there), "move" again over it; no roam here
a tree node is pointer (its item cursor where it has one); roam grabs where nothing is hovered
a draggable sankey node (draggable by default) is 'move' whatever else is written; one that is not keeps pointer; a link pointer; roam true grabs where nothing is hovered
a geo region is pointer; inside the geo's box off its regions the RoamController grabs; grabbing while it pans
a graphic element is its own `cursor`, pointer by default; a silent one is no target
a matrix cell written silent false with a cursor answers on its outline (no fill) with that cursor
a candlestick and a pictorialBar's glyphs take the item / series cursor

a continuous visualMap's handles and handle labels are ns-resize standing (ew-resize lying), its in-range bar the same when calculable, its out-of-range bar none (default); its end texts and a piecewise one's items pointer
a scrolling legend's page buttons: pointer where it can turn the page, default where it cannot
an inside dataZoom's RoamController grabs over its grid where nothing is hovered (a bar is hovered: its pointer), grabbing while it pans, grab on release
a graph's thumbnail: its box and its window are 'grab' (ThumbnailView), the copy inside silent
a toolbox icon: pointer
two graphs whose roam areas overlap, equal z: the second (enabled later) runs first; a release is for the first to decide -- grab inside its area where nothing is hovered, default outside it

steps.aim: the second only, past the first
release in the second only: its word

cases.note: the same with the first graph above (z 3): it runs first; a release is for the second to decide
a graph roam with the brush holding globalPan: a move leaves the brush crosshair; the RoamController mouseup does not look at globalPan

pictures.note: symbol image:// in the unit box scaled by half the symbol size: keepAspect centres the picture there first (so an oblong symbolSize still stretches it), without it the picture covers the box; symbolRotate turns it
a legend icon image:// in the item box, keepAspect (symbolKeepAspect, true by default) centred in the real 25 x 14 box
a graphic image without a width or a height takes its natural size once loaded; one side written scales the other by the aspect
a pictorialBar of pictures, repeated, keepAspect
a toolbox feature's image:// icon fills the item box (createIcon)
a slider dataZoom's handleIcon image:// (createSymbol keepAspect) in the handle box
